## Suggested tool: `import_price_book` — **EDIT** (writes localStorage, project-bound)

Description: "Import supplier rates from CSV text as a new price book (bookName) or as a new revision of an existing book (bookId from read_price_books), exactly as the Cost pane import does. The whole import is refused if any row is invalid; nothing partial is saved. Supplier, currency, tax basis, effective date and source reference must come from the user - never invent them. Rates only: no quantities, quotes or currency conversion."

JSON schema (`objectSchema` style, `additionalProperties: false`):
```
{
  expectedJobId: id,
  bookId:   { type: "string", format: "uuid" },            // XOR with bookName (Zod refine enforces)
  bookName: { type: "string", minLength: 1, maxLength: 120 },
  csvText:  { type: "string", minLength: 1, maxLength: 2097152 },
  fileName: { type: "string", minLength: 1, maxLength: 255 },   // default "pasted.csv"; ".tsv" defaults delimiter to tab
  delimiter:{ enum: [",", ";", "\t"] },                          // default ","
  headerRow:{ type: "integer", minimum: 1, maximum: 100 },
  mapping: objectSchema({ stockCode: { type: ["integer","null"], minimum: 0, maximum: 39 }, description: {integer 0..39}, unit: {integer 0..39}, rate: {integer 0..39} }),
  metadata: objectSchema({
    supplier: { type: "string", minLength: 1, maxLength: 200 },
    currency: { type: "string", minLength: 3, maxLength: 3 },     // uppercased/trimmed by preprocess
    amountDecimals: { type: "integer", minimum: 0, maximum: 4 },  // default 2 (panel default)
    taxBasis: { enum: ["exclusive", "inclusive", "unspecified"] },
    taxPercent: { type: ["number","null"], minimum: 0, maximum: 100 }, // default null; must be null when unspecified
    effectiveDate: { type: "string", pattern: "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$" },
    sourceReference: { type: "string", minLength: 1, maxLength: 2000 },
  }, ["supplier","currency","taxBasis","effectiveDate","sourceReference"]),
}
required: ["expectedJobId","csvText","metadata"]
```

Execute body (mirrors `apply_sheet_action`):
```ts
const args = priceImportInputSchema.parse(input), state = await port.getState(); checkProject(state, args.expectedJobId);
if (!port.storage || !port.priceBooks) throw Error("Price book storage is unavailable in this session.");
const session = port.priceBooks(state.job.id);                       // read immediately before appending
const receipt = await importPriceBook(session, args, browserPriceImportDeps());   // or { save: (s, n) => persistPriceBooks(port.storage!, s, n), readback: k => port.storage!.getItem(k) } for tests
port.priceBooksChanged?.(receipt.storageKey);                        // optional new port, see below
checkProject(await port.getState(), args.expectedJobId);
const { storageKey: _key, ...rest } = receipt; return text(rest);
```
Receipt shape: `{ jobId, storageKey, bookId, bookName, created, revision, rows, importedAt, libraryRevision, sha256, sizeBytes, fileName, delimiter, headerRow, headers, mapping, metadata, saved: true, readbackVerified: true, scope }`.

```ts

takeoff?: TakeoffPort;            // { getState(): TakeoffState }  — synchronous, fresh snapshot per call
```

`TakeoffState = Pick<ReturnType<typeof useStudio.getState>, "job"|"sheet"|"currentCalibration"|"calibrationCapture"|"calibrationError"|"traceError"|"photoError"|"tool"|"pending"|"selectedRunId"|"hydrationStatus"|"persistenceHydrated"|"persistenceRecoveryBlocked"|"persistenceError"|"lastSavedJobRevision"|"setSheet"|"startCalibrationCapture"|"cancelCalibrationCapture"|"addCalibrationPoint"|"upsertManualCalibrationCandidate"|"lockCurrentCalibration"|"setTool"|"addPoint"|"commitPending"|"clearPending"|"updateRunSpecification"|"approveRun"|"rejectRun"|"approveGate"|"rejectGate"|"removeRun">` — `useStudio.getState()` satisfies it directly (proved by the real-store test). `getState` must be synchronous: each function runs its store sequence without interleaving.

Description: "Edit, move, re-host or remove existing Architectural design entities by stable ID in one validated, undoable batch (max 25 operations). Read the design first for expectedRevision and entity IDs. Removing a wall also removes its hosted openings and dimensions; a level can only be removed when empty. Opening offsets are measured from the wall's `a` end, so include set-opening operations in the same batch when a move would leave a door or window outside its wall — the whole batch is rejected otherwise."

```
{ expectedJobId: string, expectedRevision: integer >= 1,
  operations: array (1..25) of oneOf [
    { kind: "remove", id }                                                              required [kind,id]
    { kind: "move-wall", id, a?: [x,y], b?: [x,y] }                                       required [kind,id]  (at least one of a/b)
    { kind: "set-wall", id, name?: string(1..120), heightMm?: number>0, templateWallId?: string }  required [kind,id]
    { kind: "set-level", id, name?: string(1..100), elevationMm?: number, heightMm?: number>0 }    required [kind,id]
    { kind: "set-slab", id, name?, thicknessMm?: number>0, offsetMm?: number, material?: string(<=100), points?: [[x,y]] (3..200) }  required [kind,id]
    { kind: "set-roof", id, name?, offsetMm?, eavesMm?: 0..3000, pitchDeg?: 0..89.9, gableEdges?: integer[] (each < points.length), points?: [[x,y]] (3..200) }  required [kind,id]
    { kind: "set-opening", id, offsetMm?, widthMm?: >0, heightMm?: >0, sillMm?: >=0, tag?: string(1..30), hinge?: "left"|"right", swing?: "in"|"out" }  required [kind,id]
    { kind: "rename-design", name?: string(1..200), address?: string(<=500), designRevision?: string(<=40), notes?: string(<=5000) }  required [kind]
  ] }
```
Coordinates/offsets are finite numbers within ±1e6 mm; positives are >0 and <=1e6.

v.notes: Design choices: edits mutate a structuredClone of the validated project in place via Object.assign so entity key order is preserved and revise() does not spuriously bump revisions (verified in tests: untouched walls keep their revision after a level rename or design rename). Validation runs once at the end so a move-wall + set-opening pair can be applied atomically. Level removal checks occupants before the last-level rule so the demonstration fixture reports the occupant message. Duplicate remove in a batch fails closed as not-found. set-wall with templateWallId gives new layer ids (independent identities) and refuses self-templating. set-roof: points change rebuilds edges to points.length reusing per-index pitch/gable, defaulting to 22.5 deg / not gable; pitchDeg applies to all edges; gableEdges replaces gable flags and rejects indices beyond the outline; an all-gable roof is rejected by the validator. Removed exports for the coordinator: none removed; prepareArchitectElements is byte-for-byte untouched (git diff vs HEAD also shows earlier uncommitted edits by others in architectBridge.ts that pre-date this task).
